purpose: Define one machine-checkable exact-final-candidate publication gate for the review branch. The gate sequences the existing Windows and native-WSL construction checks, the qualified Ruff lint or its documented WSL substitute, diff checks, source-only syntax checks, candidate/branch/tree identity checks, separately owned receipt/source ownership audits, adversarial-review disposition completeness, PR-body hash binding and clean-cgroup verification into a single fail-closed verdict bound to one frozen commit. It is a construction/publication gate only; it is not the inherited 87-command scientific gate, not scientific admission, and not merge approval.

observed_facts_reflected.github_evidence: Merged PRs 120-123 have zero GitHub statusCheckRollup entries and zero GitHub review objects; their acceptance evidence was internal and candidate-bound. This gate therefore treats internal retained receipts as the acceptance evidence, does not require or consult GitHub status checks or review objects, and fails if the PR body claims GitHub-side checks or reviews that do not exist.
observed_facts_reflected.checkpoint_history: construction-checkpoint-gate-01 FAILED because it added a WSL Ruff step although Ruff is not installed in the native environment; construction-checkpoint-gate-02 PASSED on cdd20b990e5e7bad99c1832332cdd1b37a40130e with windows-unittest, windows-ruff, diff-check, wsl-unittest and wsl-source-pycompile. Windows Ruff is the qualified lint route; the documented WSL substitute is source-only py_compile.
observed_facts_reflected.moving_candidate: PR124 is a draft with a moving head; no immutable exact-current-candidate complete Windows or WSL gate receipt exists yet. Publication remains OPEN_MOVING_CANDIDATE until the freeze step of this gate.
observed_facts_reflected.scientific_separation: scientific_admission remains BLOCKED_NO_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZED on a separate track; a PASS of this gate is construction-only and must never be read as scientific acceptance, execution authorization or control results.
observed_facts_reflected.internal_receipt_convention: Receipt presence is not proof of contents; ownership audits must re-verify receipt bodies, log bytes and source membership before the verdict may pass.

definitions.canonical_json: UTF-8, no BOM, sorted keys, no duplicate keys, no nonfinite numbers, separators (',',':'), single trailing newline

inputs.name: frozen_candidate_commit
inputs.requirement: 40-hex commit; equals git rev-parse HEAD on both Windows and WSL workspaces at every check; the current draft head cdd20b990e5e7bad99c1832332cdd1b37a40130e is a checkpoint observation, NOT the frozen value
inputs.unresolved_reason: final candidate not yet frozen; integrations must stop first

inputs.name: frozen_candidate_tree
inputs.requirement: 40-hex tree of frozen_candidate_commit via git rev-parse HEAD^{tree}

inputs.name: command_manifest
inputs.requirement: One canonical JSON manifest naming every check id below, its exact argv per host, expected test counts, expected skip counts, the campaign source file list with sha256 entries, and frozen_candidate_commit/tree. Manifest sha256 is fixed before any gate command runs.
inputs.unresolved_reason: manifest file does not exist yet

inputs.name: campaign_source_manifest_entries
inputs.requirement: Sorted list of {path, sha256, bytes} covering at minimum experiments/v3/swarm-research-20260911-155142/{boundary.py,inventory_audit.py,boundary_audit.py,boundary_controls.py,research_entry.py}; last tracked sha256 values are recorded in scientific-admission-status-01.json but the manifest must re-derive them from the frozen candidate

inputs.name: gate_attempt_ordinal
inputs.requirement: Monotonically increasing integer; each run of this gate is a new attempt; prior attempts are retained and never rewritten or reused

inputs.name: pr_body_bytes
inputs.requirement: Final non-draft PR body as exact UTF-8 bytes; sha256 recorded in manifest before final reviews run
inputs.unresolved_reason: final PR body not yet written

inputs.name: receipt_root_native
inputs.requirement: Append-only; every artifact below lands here with exclusive create, fsynced file and directory

inputs.name: receipt_root_windows
inputs.requirement: Windows-host retained artifact directory for windows-side logs/receipts; exact path is part of the command manifest
inputs.unresolved_reason: Windows retained path not named in packet

inputs.name: owned_audit_receipts
inputs.requirement: Two separately owned audit receipts (distinct owner identity from the gate runner and from each other), each OWNED_RETAINED_AUDIT_PASS-bound to every gate receipt, log and source member

inputs.name: adversarial_review_bundle
inputs.requirement: At least two independent final reviews bound to frozen_candidate_commit, command_manifest sha256, every gate receipt sha256, both audit sha256s, pr_body sha256 and the limitations text. Reviewer identities distinct. Reviewer set per model-revision-01 (gpt-5.6-sol xhigh where same-model review is required) plus the established adversarial coordinator route; exact reviewer list is fixed in the manifest.

inputs.name: disposition_table
inputs.requirement: Canonical JSON mapping every reservation/defect/blocking_gap/dissent item id in the review bundle to {item_id, disposition in disposition_values, reason, evidence_sha256_or_null}

inputs.name: quota_observation
inputs.requirement: usage record refreshed by an actual quota observation, age <= 900s at gate start and before verdict emission; remaining_percent above the 8-point rolling reserve; reset_credits_used == 0; new_metered_spend == 0

inputs.name: clock_bounds
inputs.requirement: Verdict must be emitted before deadline minus finalization reserve

commands: re-hash each review file; compare fields
pass_conditions: at least two independent final review records exist with distinct reviewer identities
each review binds frozen_candidate_commit, manifest sha256, every gate check receipt sha256, both owned-audit sha256s, pr_body sha256 and the limitations text verbatim

pass_conditions: every reservation, defect, blocking_gap and dissent item in every bound review appears exactly once in disposition_table

each disposition is one of disposition_values with a nonempty reason; fixed-in-candidate must cite evidence_sha256 (commit or artifact); deferred-owner-bound must cite the owning record that binds the deferral
disposition_table sha256 is recorded in the verdict; no review item is silently dropped

known live items that must appear if still asserted: moving-candidate gap, absent exact-current-candidate WSL/full gate receipts, unsupported PR120/PR123 body claims, weak PR122 receipt coverage, wave06 unfavorable outcomes

commands: sha256 over final pr_body_bytes; field scan
pass_conditions: sha256(pr_body_bytes) equals the value bound into manifest and final reviews
body contains: frozen_candidate_commit, verdict attempt ordinal, every gate check receipt sha256, both owned-audit sha256s, review bundle sha256s, disposition_table sha256, and a limitations section

honesty rule: body must not claim GitHub status checks, GitHub reviews or required-checks protection as evidence (observed: zero exist on PRs 120-124); acceptance evidence is internal receipts only and the body must say so
body must state scientific admission remains BLOCKED_NO_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZED and that this gate is construction-only
body is published on the review branch as non-draft only after verdict PASS_CONSTRUCTION_ONLY; merge authority is Lucas alone

commands: emit publication-gate verdict record (canonical_json) into receipt_root_native
pass_conditions: PASS_CONSTRUCTION_ONLY requires every prior check PASS on the same frozen_candidate_commit and same attempt ordinal
verdict re-runs freeze-and-scope identity assertions immediately before emission; any drift downgrades to FAIL_CANDIDATE_DRIFT
verdict.status in verdict_status; verdict.scientific_admission == 'BLOCKED_NO_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZED'; verdict.accepted == false; verdict.merge_authority == 'Lucas alone'

outputs.retention: All receipts, logs, review files, disposition table and PR body snapshot are retained immutably under receipt_root_native and receipt_root_windows; artifacts are created exclusively, fsynced, and hash-linked; no deletion or rewrite is permitted

failure_behavior.fail_closed: verdict is PASS_CONSTRUCTION_ONLY only if every check PASSes; any FAIL yields FAIL; any check that cannot run, times out, loses its host, or depends on an unresolved placeholder yields INCOMPLETE (never PASS)
failure_behavior.candidate_drift: HEAD/tree is re-verified before each host check and before verdict emission; drift aborts the attempt as FAIL_CANDIDATE_DRIFT and invalidates all receipts of that attempt for any other candidate
failure_behavior.no_retry_identity: a failed or unknown attempt is never retried under the same gate_attempt_ordinal; the reservation of that attempt's evidence is nonrefundable and retained
failure_behavior.no_receipt_rewriting: existing receipts, logs and reviews are never edited; corrections are new artifacts in a later attempt
failure_behavior.host_unreachable: Windows host unavailability records UNKNOWN on the windows-side checks and INCOMPLETE verdict; WSL-native PASS receipts cannot satisfy or impersonate the Windows checks (validation-contract full_gate_blocker)
failure_behavior.github_absence_is_not_failure: zero GitHub statusCheckRollup/review objects never fails the gate; claiming them in the PR body does fail pr-body-hash-binding

rerun_rules: any new commit or tree change on the review branch: complete rerun from freeze-and-scope under a new attempt ordinal; no check result is carried over across candidates

any repair that does not move the candidate but changes manifest, PR body, disposition table or review bundle: rerun from preregistration onward for changed inputs; checks whose bound evidence is unchanged may be re-verified by hash rather than re-executed only if the manifest explicitly lists them as hash-stable
any new review reservation/defect: extend disposition_table and rerun disposition-completeness and verdict
any PR body edit: rerun pr-body-hash-binding, disposition-completeness and verdict; final reviews must re-bind the new pr_body_sha256 if the body changed after review
post-repair candidate change additionally requires fresh final reviews bound to the new candidate before verdict
all attempts must finish verdict emission before campaign deadline minus finalization_reserve_seconds; an attempt that cannot meet the bound records INCOMPLETE_DEADLINE
non_goals: scientific admission, execution authorization, or any model/reducer/control execution
the inherited 87-command full gates (separate Windows-bound track; this gate does not claim their equivalence)
merge, PR approval, or any GitHub-side state change; Lucas alone merges
receipt rewriting, fake host/path predicates, monkeypatched checks, or unrun PASS
unresolved_placeholders: frozen_candidate_commit / frozen_candidate_tree values (freeze step produces them)
command_manifest file and its sha256, including exact argv for windows-unittest, windows-ruff, wsl-unittest, diff-check, and both owned auditors
final reviewer identity list (must satisfy model-revision-01 where same-model review is required)
Windows-side quiescence attestation mechanism inside clean-cgroup
expected test/skip counts (recorded in manifest at freeze time; never hardcoded)
preserved_limitations: The unchanged inherited 87-command gates are Windows-host/path-bound and cannot pass truthfully in WSL; this construction gate neither satisfies nor impersonates them.
Ruff is not installed in the native WSL environment; the only admitted native lint evidence is the documented py_compile substitute plus the qualified Windows Ruff route.
The candidate was still moving at last observation and no immutable exact-current-candidate Windows or WSL gate receipt exists; this proposal defines the gate and does not claim it ran.
Receipt presence or hash identity is not proof of contents; the two separately owned audits exist precisely because internal receipts are the acceptance evidence.

Control-suite accounting remains unresolved: the conservative global-additive bound (~296979 units) exceeds the 76582-unit shared-inventory control margin, and no admitted ledger mapping exists; this gate does not settle it.
Some retained controls may remain unavailable-reachable-witness on real shards, forcing INCOMPLETE_FIXED_CONTROL_SUITE on the scientific track; preserved here as unresolved.
Merged PRs 120-123 show the GitHub UI never encoded the claimed workflow; only internal candidate-bound receipts carry acceptance, and the gate encodes that explicitly.
